parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all three error targets: it removes the false claim that the comment concretely specifies how to implement the comparison (factual error and rubric misapplication), removes the unsupported inference about authors knowing exactly what to do and running experiments (unsupported inference), and revises the rubric application to note that the action is implicit and vague without stating a numeric score or gold label. The corrected text preserves the original observation that the comment only implies a comparison should be added and maintains coherence. No numeric score or gold label is directly stated.
